answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a vital ledge for AI agency, requiring cryptographically verified biometric or social attestation to prevent identity duplication. Like a ship tethered to a wharf, an agent must bind its computational presence to a unique human signature to participate. This forces attackers to acquire scarce biological credentials, turning a low-cost digital zephyr of fake nodes into an expensive operational bottleneck that renders mass Sybil deployment economically irrational and structurally impossible.
